prompt: Create a clean, child-friendly educational vocabulary poster for preschool/kindergarten children, inspired by a simple visual learning card. Feature [FRUIT] as the main large realistic object on the left, and show a [PART / SLICE / SEGMENT] of the same fruit on the right. Connect the two with a playful dotted curved arrow and a tiny simple stick-figure child pointing toward the smaller part. Add the word “[FRUIT NAME]” in large bold uppercase letters at the top and “[PART NAME]” in large bold uppercase letters underneath the smaller image. Use a soft white and very light pastel-blue background, rounded image panels, clean spacing, realistic fruit photography, simple blue typography, and minimal playful illustrations. The overall design should feel bright, educational, modern, uncluttered, and easy for young children to understand, like a premium preschool vocabulary learning card. Vertical 4:5 composition, high resolution, soft lighting, clear labels, no unnecessary decorations.

promptZh: 为学龄前/幼儿园儿童创作一张简洁且适合儿童的教育词汇海报，灵感来源于简单的视觉学习卡。将 [水果] 作为左侧主要的逼真大图，并在右侧展示该水果的 [部分 / 切片 / 分段]。用一条俏皮的虚线弧形箭头将两者连接起来，并配上一个小巧简单的火柴人儿童指向较小的部分。在顶部用醒目的粗体大写字母添加单词 “[水果名称]”，并在较小图像下方用醒目的粗体大写字母添加 “[部分名称]”。使用柔和的白色和极浅的淡蓝色背景、圆角图像面板、简洁的间距、逼真的水果摄影、简单的蓝色排版以及极简的趣味插图。整体设计应显得明亮、具有教育意义、现代、整洁，且易于幼儿理解，如同高级学龄前词汇学习卡。4:5 竖构图，高分辨率，柔和光线，标签清晰，无多余装饰。
